description: This file provides an API for sending messages, polls, reactions, and presence updates via WhatsApp using the Baileys library, including functions for recording outbound message activity.

methods.name: recordWhatsAppOutbound
methods.description: Records outbound WhatsApp channel activity for a given account ID.

methods.name: resolveOutboundMessageId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the message ID from a result object.

methods.name: createWebSendApi
methods.description: Creates an API object with methods to send messages, polls, reactions, and presence updates over WhatsApp.
